args.text: Start a note to June about the PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb, and Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'. Post the bullets here.

args.subject: Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail): PHL label confusion
args.body:
June,

Note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The CRM code changed from CLR to PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal), so filtering on PHL returns both accounts. Use the full account name in subject lines and dropdowns.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It needs the Pellow Home Living name. Sofia has this on her list to relabel.
- Older exports and some yard reports still show the Covey & Lark header.

From Sofia Marchetti (draft prepared by assistant for Sofia to review before sending).
